messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف معلومات غير موجودة، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON فقط وفق الشكل: {"book_code":"APMO","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"..."}]}. أخرج وحدة واحدة لكل مدخل بالترتيب. إذا كان مرجع المصدر مجمّعاً مثل 1,2 فترجم نصه مرة واحدة واجعل verse أول رقم فقط، ولا تقسّمه إلى وحدتين.

{"book_code":"APMO","units":[{"chapter":22,"text":"and mine, broke out into flowers. And the throne of God was fixed where the Tree of Life was.","source_ref":"22:4"},{"chapter":23,"text":"And God called Adam saying, \"Adam, where art thou? Can the house be hidden from the presence","source_ref":"23:1"},{"chapter":23,"text":"of its builder? \"Then your father answered; \"It is not because we think not to be found by thee, Lord, that we hide, but I was afraid, because I am naked, and I was ashamed before thy might,","source_ref":"23:2"},{"chapter":23,"text":"(my) Master.\" God saith to him, \"Who showed thee that thou art naked, unless thou hast forsaken my","source_ref":"23:3"},{"chapter":23,"text":"commandment, which I delivered thee to keep (it).\" Then Adam called to mind the word which I spake to him, (saying) \"I will make thee secure before God\"; and he turned and said to me: \"Why hast thou done this?\" And I said, \"The serpent deceived me.\"","source_ref":"23:4"}]}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return one item per input unit, in input order, using the first printed number when a source label is grouped: 22:4, 23:1, 23:2, 23:3, 23:4.
